notes: A modern Uncharted Waters: New Horizons — painterly early-modern North European trading port. 73 Director-approved environment plates (2026-07-30). Captions are CONTENT-ONLY prose, trigger-first ('saltroad style, <subject>') sourced from canon.subject — style vocabulary belongs to the trigger, never the caption. Uses caption_strategy 'subject-natural-language' because this project's judgment.explanation holds curation RULINGS, not scene text, so flux-natural-language would bake review metadata into every caption. eligible_lanes empty (lane-mismatch gotcha drops all rows otherwise). Steps 2500 not 3000: 73 images at 3000 is ~41 epochs and overfits; checkpoints every 250 give 10 candidates to A/B locally at zero extra GPU cost (single-lever discipline — one run, many checkpoints, never a confounded sweep).
